name: Sparkline (what is versus what could be)
summary: Alternate between the current reality and a better future to build tension, then end with a call to action and a vision of the new bliss.
title_style: Short evocative phrases, under 8 words; contrast words between what is and what could be.

sequence.purpose: Open with a vivid picture of today.
Describe what is, as the audience lives it.
Describe what could be, in contrast.
Swing between what is and what could be to build tension.
The moment the gap feels unbearable.
The call to action that closes the gap.
End on the new bliss: the reward for acting.

pitfalls: Staying in the current state too long; the swings keep energy up.
A call to action without a picture of the reward after it.
Contrasts so abstract the audience cannot see either side.

example.topic: A fictional design studio replacing status emails with a shared board
outline: Our day belongs to the inbox
Imagine a Monday with zero status emails
Chasing updates vs. seeing them live
We lose one full day a week to this
Move one team to the shared board this month
A week where work talks for itself
